content.content:
## Description

While the [ChatInput](../chat-input/index.md#chat-input)'s Ask tab is selected, the conversation fills the body's Chat tab, beneath the tab bar and above the chat input, in place of the message list, as the [Body](../../application/Body.md#body) says, never sharing the body with it or with anything else. It goes when another mode's tab is selected, the message list coming back in its place, and comes back as it was, scrolled where it was, when Ask is selected again. Nothing slides as it comes and goes.
It is drawn in the [Theme](../../../ui/theme/index.md#theme)'s roles, on the same base surface as the message list. Along its top runs a header 32 pixels tall, on the tab bar's background with the theme's line beneath it, reading "Questions" at its left, with 12 pixels of padding, and at its right how many questions it holds, muted. Beneath it, the conversation spans the full width of the space it fills, from the body's left edge to its right, or to the right sidebar while it is there, its questions and answers laid out across all of it with only its own padding at either side, never set in a narrower column, centred or not, and never leaving empty space beside it. It widens and narrows with the body as the window or a sidebar is resized.

content.text:
The Ask conversation now spans the full width of the Chat tab: from the body's left edge to its right, or to the right sidebar while it's open. Only the conversation's own padding sits at the sides, and it widens and narrows as the window or a sidebar is resized.

The cause was a centred 760px column cap in `src/prompt_mode/ask_pane.rs`, which I removed. I added a width check to the Ask-tab UI test, and it and the other Ask tests pass.

Two tests matching "ask" still fail: `code_tasks_reach_the_harness_as_text` and `where_a_task_was_sent_from_is_not_sent`. They fail because of the uncommitted spec rename from `ApplicationScope` to `Application`, not this change.

The spec and the prompt agree here.
